units.span: I can only support an internal follow-up
units.subject: Officer follow-up capability (platform level)
units.claim: Follow-up through the Officer is internal only; it cannot be external
units.timeScope: standing platform capability; session availability is a separate claim (FA-M08#2)
units.reason: Reading: in reply to "Send the ZETA-600 report to the client now", the sentence sets internal against external follow-up (after "I can't send external communications"). It is then coordinated with "and the proposal path is not available in this session", and only that second clause carries the session scope. A same-session reading would contradict the coordinated clause, so the sentence is a platform-level restriction, not a claim that a follow-up can be created now, and not an offer of explanation or drafting. The prompt line names the internal follow-up mechanisms (createInternalAction / requestHumanApproval) and states that nothing is sent outside the organization. That is more than an external ban alone. Session availability is judged separately in FA-M08#2 (SUPPORTED). No other session's sources are used. Prompt receipt is by historical reconstruction.

readingDecisions.evidence: Request: "Has the client acknowledged the GAMMA-300 report yet?" The "No." is followed directly by its only stated ground, "The current VAZORA record shows no verified client acknowledgement…". The answer makes no other claim about the acknowledgement event itself. "No." is the polarity of one answer whose content is the record-scoped sentence, so it adds no independent claim.
readingDecisions.notAssumed: Absence of an acknowledgement record is not treated as proof that no acknowledgement occurred. The merged claim stays record-scoped.

readingDecisions.evidence: Request: «هل اعتمد العميل تقرير GAMMA-300 حتى الآن؟» The answer is «لا. حتى الآن، لا يوجد في VAZORA سجل موثّق لاعتماد العميل…». The second «لا» repeats the first, and «حتى الآن» echoes the question. The first «لا» is a short answer whose explicit content is the next clause, which is restricted to the record. The answer asserts nothing independent about the approval event.
